ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, hairlines, card and input borders, list dividers, link underlines — the dominant dark anchor of the system

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Icon fills, heading underlines, occasional deep accents where maximum weight is needed

bone.$description: Bone — Page background, card surface, text on filled buttons, button borders for ghost controls

linen.$description: Linen — Section band background, elevated card surface, the warm neutral that gives the white space its temperature

ash.$description: Ash — Footer divider, hairline rules where Ink would be too heavy

cobalt-pulse.$description: Cobalt Pulse — Single primary action fill per page — the only chromatic punctuation, reserved for the decisive CTA and never used decoratively

ember-signal.$description: Ember Signal — Rare secondary action or notification accent — a warm counterpoint to Cobalt Pulse, used at most once per surface

sana-sans.$description: Sole typeface across the entire system — display headlines at 83px set weight 500 with -2.5% tracking for a carved, architectural feel; section headings at 48px weight 500 with -0.96px tracking; body copy at 15-16px weight 400 with barely-perceptible negative tracking. The font is geometric and humanist, and the refusal to go above weight 500 is deliberate: confidence comes from restraint, not boldness.
